recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central framed photograph of a man in motion against a textured urban wall, overlaid with two distinct styles of expressive hand-lettering: a large, bold red script at the top and a casual black marker-style script within the photo frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the flat grey outer border and the warm-toned inner photograph
Dynamic tension between the running figure and the static wall graffiti
Visual weight balance between the top-heavy red title and the bottom-right figure
Interaction of the red script's descender with the top edge of the photo frame
coreInvariants: A neutral grey outer margin framing the central image
A man in a dark blazer and light trousers captured in a running stride
A textured, two-tone wall (light top, dark bottom) serving as the backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The running man is positioned in the lower right quadrant of the inner frame, scaled to approximately one-third of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red script at the top acts as the primary visual anchor, dominating the upper third of the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red title, moves down to the graffiti text on the left, and follows the man's running direction toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the grey border and the empty sections of the wall behind the figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey (outer frame) and beige/tan (wall texture).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (top lettering) provides high-energy contrast against the grey.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black (graffiti text and blazer) grounds the composition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red title against muted, desaturated tones in the photograph and border.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn script and casual marker handwriting.
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thick, uneven brush strokes with sharp terminals and a long horizontal flourish on the final character.
Inner text: Casual, slanted handwriting with varying pressure, mimicking a felt-tip marker on a wall.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'k' with an elongated, sharp ascender
Final 's' with a horizontal tail extending across the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between bold, stylized display script and raw, amateurish street handwriting.
graphicDevices: Thin black border around the central photograph
Horizontal dividing line on the wall texture

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the energy and weight of the top title.
Matches the 'graffiti' style of the inner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a dark blazer, light blue shirt, and tan pants running past a textured beige wall with a dark brown base. The scene is framed by a thick neutral grey border with a thin black inner stroke. The lighting is flat, reminiscent of 1980s street photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold red hand-drawn script across the top grey area, slightly overlapping the photo frame. Add black marker-style handwriting in a staggered three-line layout on the left side of the beige wall inside the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the red text bold and expressive?
Does the man appear to be in mid-stride?
Is the grey border clearly defined?
Does the inner text look like marker graffiti?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the man
Exact letterforms of the original brand name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is the most vibrant element.
Check that the figure's motion feels dynamic.
Verify the 'graffiti' text looks integrated into the wall texture.
Confirm the grey border provides sufficient breathing room.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured urban action photo with a thick neutral frame, then layer high-contrast bold script at the top and casual marker-style handwriting within the image scene.
